epithet: The Glass Citadel and the Margin

places.name: The Glass Citadel
places.epithet: Fortified, and full of very careful people
places.text: Phais's fortress on the town's high ground, walled and garrisoned: the Weave's gate toward The Crown, and the keep that watches everything leaving Northreach for the capital.
places.source: Of Northreach Weave, the Iron Threshold

places.name: The Temple of Phais
places.epithet: Questions whose answers would need to be recorded
places.text: A large temple within the walls. Its priests feed and house the people of the Margin outside them, and ask no questions whose answers would need to be recorded.
places.source: Of Northreach Weave, the Iron Threshold

places.name: The Glassworks
places.text: Furnace-halls where the circuits of Glass Circuitry, designed in the Crucible, are blown, along with most of the Vessels' glass linings and a surprising quantity of fine jewellery and southern-bound wine.
places.source: Of Northreach Weave, the Iron Threshold

places.name: The Circuit House
places.text: Where finished circuits are tested before they go north, in rooms kept apart from one another for reasons described as technical and discussed as superstitious.
places.source: Of Northreach Weave, the Iron Threshold

places.name: The Twice-Gate
places.epithet: Everything leaving Northreach is inspected twice
places.text: The south-east gate, on the Iron Road to The Crown. Everything bound for the capital passes through it and is inspected, and then, at the inner yard, inspected again.
places.source: Of Northreach Weave, the Iron Threshold

places.name: The Margin
places.text: The shanty-quarter sprawling outside the walls, where artificers rotated out of the Crucible go when they have nowhere else to go, and where 'reassigned' bonding subjects tend, eventually, to surface.
places.source: Of Northreach Weave, the Iron Threshold

places.name: The Walls of Phais
places.text: Walled and fortified, as befits the Weave's gate toward The Crown.
places.source: Of Northreach Weave, the Iron Threshold

places.name: The Glass Market
places.text: The square inside the walls where jewellers and wine-glass merchants sell what the glassworks make for people who are not the Crucible.

places.name: The Iron Road
places.text: South from Phais round the western foot of the Everstorm's mountain and through the Ironward stormgate to The Crown.
places.source: Of Northreach Weave, the Iron Threshold
